articles.title: Bakery Turns Crime Scene: Woman Slashed with Knife in Public View, CCTV Horror Shocks Ahmedabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking knife attack was reported from the Behrampura area of Ahmedabad, Gujarat, where a young man allegedly assaulted a married woman with a large, sword-like knife inside a bakery while she was shopping.

body.html:
A shocking knife attack was reported from the Behrampura area of Ahmedabad, Gujarat, where a young man allegedly assaulted a married woman with a large, sword-like knife inside a bakery while she was shopping. The incident, which occurred in full public view, was captured on CCTV and has since gone viral on social media, triggering widespread fear and outrage.

According to police, the woman sustained injuries to her hands while trying to defend herself and was immediately rushed to a nearby hospital. Doctors said her condition is stable and the injuries are serious but not life-threatening.

CCTV footage shows the woman standing inside the bakery when the accused approached her and questioned why she was roaming alone and why she was not talking to him. When she refused to respond, the man allegedly lost his temper, pulled out a knife and attacked her repeatedly. The video shows him striking her around four times as she tried to dodge the blows and move away.

Panic broke out inside the shop within seconds as customers and locals rushed in. The bakery owner can be seen in the footage giving the injured woman a cloth to tie around her bleeding hands as she cried in pain. She was later taken to hospital for medical treatment.

Police identified the victim as Tamanna Mohsin Sheikh and the accused as Rahim, also known as Noman Latif Sheikh. According to police sources, the two had known each other for a short period after Tamanna’s divorce. Their relationship deteriorated after she remarried Mohsin, following which several disputes arose. Multiple cases related to the matter are currently pending in court.

Police further revealed that the accused had earlier attempted to attack the woman’s relatives with swords in a separate incident, which is also sub judice. Tamanna had earlier stayed at her grandmother’s house, where she came in contact with Rahim. After her remarriage, she cut off all communication, which allegedly led to repeated confrontations.

On the night of the incident, Tamanna had gone to a shop near her aunt’s house when the accused arrived. When she ignored him, he allegedly abused her verbally before launching the knife attack.

A formal complaint has been registered, CCTV footage has been seized, and police teams are conducting raids to trace and detain the accused. Authorities said strict legal action will be taken as per law.

The incident has sparked widespread anger on social media, with many users raising concerns over women’s safety, repeat offenders, and the lack of real-time monitoring despite the presence of CCTV cameras. Police have urged people not to spread rumours or hateful content and assured that the case is being dealt with seriously.

articles.title: Old Rivalry Erupts, Elderly Among Six Seriously Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wedding ceremony in Rampur Fatehpur village, under the Dadri police station area of Greater Noida, descended into violence on Friday after a long-standing rivalry between two groups flared up, leaving several people seriously injured.

body.html:
A wedding ceremony in Rampur Fatehpur village, under the Dadri police station area of Greater Noida, descended into violence on Friday after a long-standing rivalry between two groups flared up, leaving several people seriously injured.

According to the police, the clash broke out during the Chadhat ceremony when 30 to 40 people allegedly attacked a group of wedding guests over an old personal dispute. The injured were rushed to Kailash Hospital in Greater Noida, where several of them are undergoing treatment in the ICU.

Soran Pradhan, national president of the Kisan Ekta Sangh, said that the victims are his relatives from Jaganpur village in Dankaur. He stated that around five to six months ago, his relatives—Devendra, Deshraj and others—had an altercation with a local farmer leader. A village panchayat was later held, but the rivalry reportedly continued, with the opposing group allegedly seeking revenge since then.

On Friday, when Pradhan’s relatives arrived in Rampur Fatehpur village to attend the wedding, the dispute escalated into a violent attack. The injured have been identified as Deshraj (80), Jagdish (70), Devendra (55), Virendra (50), Rajendra (45) and Srinivas (47). All sustained serious injuries.

Police reached the spot soon after the incident and shifted the injured to hospital. The victims’ family members have submitted a named complaint, following which a case has been registered. Police teams have launched a search operation to arrest the accused.

An investigation is currently underway.

#GreaterNoida #WeddingViolence #Dadri #UPCrime #VillageRivalry #KisanEktaSangh #LawAndOrder

articles.title: ‘Reel’ Turns Into Arrest: Youths Held for Vulgar Remarks at Narsinghpur Bus Stand
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in the Stationganj police station area of Narsinghpur, Madhya Pradesh, have arrested two young men for allegedly making lewd and objectionable remarks at young women and uploading the video on social media.

body.html:
Police in the Stationganj police station area of Narsinghpur, Madhya Pradesh, have arrested two young men for allegedly making lewd and objectionable remarks at young women and uploading the video on social media.

According to police, the incident took place on Friday at the Stationganj bus stand, where the two youths, riding a motorcycle, recorded a 30–40 second video using highly offensive and vulgar language towards women present at the spot. The video was later uploaded on Instagram and other social media platforms as a “Reel”, triggering public outrage.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, Stationganj police station in-charge Saurabh Patel constituted a team to trace the accused. The two adult youths were soon identified and taken into custody. During interrogation, the accused claimed they had shot the video as a “joke”.

Terming the act as serious and an affront to the dignity of women, police registered a case against the two youths. Following their arrest, the accused uploaded another video on their Instagram accounts, publicly admitting their mistake and apologising.

Narsinghpur SDOP Manoj Gupta said that strict instructions were issued by Superintendent of Police Dr Rishikesh Meena to take immediate and stringent legal action. He warned that anyone indulging in indecent behaviour on social media under the guise of making jokes would face strict consequences.

#Narsinghpur #MadhyaPradesh #ViralVideo #SocialMediaAbuse #WomenSafety #PoliceAction #ReelCulture #LawAndOrder

articles.title: Boyfriend Locked in Trunk for 45 Minutes: Love Affair Sparks Chaos in Kanpur Home
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident unfolded in Kanpur’s Chakeri area on Friday, where a young man was found locked inside a trunk for nearly 45 minutes after visiting his girlfriend’s house in the absence of her family members.

body.html:
A dramatic incident unfolded in Kanpur’s Chakeri area on Friday, where a young man was found locked inside a trunk for nearly 45 minutes after visiting his girlfriend’s house in the absence of her family members.

According to police, the girl had called her neighbour, a youth living a few houses away, to her residence in the morning after her mother left for work and her brother went out with a tractor. The young man reached her house on his motorcycle at around 11:30 am.

Shortly thereafter, the girl’s aunt arrived at the house and allegedly heard a male voice coming from one of the rooms. Sensing something suspicious, she knocked on the door repeatedly, but the girl refused to open it. The aunt then locked the main gate from outside and informed the girl’s mother and brother.

When the family returned and searched the house, they did not find anyone initially. However, they soon heard noises coming from a locked trunk kept inside the room. Despite this, the girl denied that anyone was inside and refused to hand over the key.

As the family attempted to break open the trunk, the police were informed. A police team reached the spot around noon and directed the girl to open the trunk. Upon unlocking it, her boyfriend emerged from inside, leaving the family shocked.

Police intervened to prevent enraged family members from assaulting the youth and escorted both the girl and the young man to the police station for questioning.

Chakeri SHO Ajay Prakash Mishra said the youth is a resident of the same locality and that further inquiry into the matter is underway.

#KanpurNews #UPPolice #LoveAffair #ShockingIncident #Chakeri #ViralNews #FamilyDrama

articles.title: Love, Lies and Beef Trap: Lucknow Woman Frames Husband Twice to Live With Lover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a case that reads like a crime thriller, a woman from Lucknow allegedly orchestrated an elaborate conspiracy to frame her husband, Wasim, twice in cow slaughter cases so that she could live with her lover, Amaan.

body.html:
In a case that reads like a crime thriller, a woman from Lucknow allegedly orchestrated an elaborate conspiracy to frame her husband, Wasim, twice in cow slaughter cases so that she could live with her lover, Amaan. Police say the plan involved deception, fake identities, planted evidence and misuse of religious sensitivities.

According to Lucknow Police, the woman and Amaan became acquainted through Instagram nearly two years ago. Amaan, a BTech graduate in computer science from Bhopal, frequently travelled to Lucknow to meet her. The woman holds a postgraduate degree in English literature from Aligarh Muslim University, while her husband Wasim is a businessman in the paper industry.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (Lucknow West) Vishwajeet Srivastava said the conspiracy was first conceived in August last year. The objective was to have Wasim arrested in a cow slaughter case, thereby paving the way for a divorce and his prolonged incarceration.

In September, Amaan allegedly joined Bajrang Dal using a fake Hindu identity under the name “Rahul”. With keys provided by the woman, he allegedly planted around 30 kilograms of meat in Wasim’s Mahindra Thar, which was parked at a Hazratganj parking lot. He then tipped off Hindu activists, who informed the police. The meat was recovered, and Wasim was arrested. He spent nearly a month in jail before being released on bail, after the case was later found to be fabricated.

When the first attempt failed to achieve the desired outcome, the woman allegedly planned a second trap. On 14 January, she booked an online transport vehicle using Wasim’s mobile phone and shared the OTP with Amaan. He reportedly brought 12 kilograms of cow meat from Bhopal.

An e-rickshaw was directed to collect a gunny bag containing the consignment from the Old City area of Lucknow, with the drop location set near Wasim’s factory in Kakori. Once again, Amaan allegedly alerted members of a Hindu organisation, who passed on the information to the police. On 15 January, Kakori police intercepted the vehicle and seized the meat. Wasim was again detained, as the rickshaw driver possessed both his and his wife’s phone numbers.

During questioning, Wasim informed police that he had installed CCTV cameras at home, suspecting his wife of having an affair. On reviewing the footage, police found that the woman had accessed his phone to receive the OTP while he was in the washroom. Further investigation revealed her communication with Amaan.

Inspector Satish Chandra Rathore of Kakori police station stated that Amaan used Wasim’s identity documents to book the online porter from Aminabad to Kakori. The beef was transported from Bhopal, concealed in a cardboard box, and deliberately positioned to ensure police interception. To hasten action, Amaan again tipped off Bajrang Dal members under a false identity.

Police further revealed that the accused met on 31 December and even procured a SIM card in a beggar’s name to coordinate the delivery.

On 18 January, police laid a trap and arrested Amaan, who allegedly confessed to the conspiracy. However, the woman had already absconded. Acting on intelligence, a police team attempted to arrest her at the Allahabad High Court campus on 20 January. During the operation, chaos broke out after lawyers protested against the police for allegedly providing misleading information and trespassing. Taking advantage of the commotion, the woman managed to escape.

Three police personnel were subsequently suspended and booked for trespassing. While Amaan remains in custody, police say the search is on to trace the absconding woman.

articles.title: Mumbai Home Massage Turns Violent: Client, Therapist Brawl After Session Cancelled in Wadala
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A home massage appointment in Mumbai’s Wadala area spiralled into a physical fight between a 46-year-old woman and an Urban Company massage therapist after the client cancelled the session over concerns about space and privacy.

body.html:
A home massage appointment in Mumbai’s Wadala area spiralled into a physical fight between a 46-year-old woman and an Urban Company massage therapist after the client cancelled the session over concerns about space and privacy. A video of the incident, recorded by the woman’s son, has since gone viral on social media, sparking public outrage.

The incident took place on Wednesday, January 21, 2026. The client, identified as Shenaz, also known as Shahnaz Wahid Sayyed, had booked a massage session scheduled for 4:30 pm to treat a frozen shoulder. The therapist, identified as Neelam Kumari Jaiswal, reportedly arrived early and began setting up a massage bed in the living room.

According to police, Shenaz objected to the size of the massage bed and expressed concerns over privacy, following which she cancelled the session. An argument broke out over the cancellation, which soon escalated into a physical altercation.

Police said the therapist allegedly pulled Shenaz’s hair, punched her and scratched her face. When the woman’s 18-year-old son intervened to stop the fight, he was also allegedly attacked. The video, recorded by the son, shows both women pulling each other’s hair, exchanging punches and falling onto a bed during the scuffle.

As the situation worsened, Shenaz called the police helpline number 100. The therapist reportedly fled the spot before police arrived.

Wadala TT Police have registered a non-cognisable (NC) offence against the therapist, which restricts further investigation unless directed by a court. Officials said the video footage is being examined.

Urban Company, the service platform through which the booking was made, said the therapist has been immediately removed from the platform. The company also stated that it is cooperating fully with the police and has reached out to the client.

The video clip, widely shared on platforms such as X (formerly Twitter) and Instagram, has triggered debate over safety, accountability and dispute handling in app-based home services.

articles.title: Intern Doctor Allegedly Assaulted by Chief Warden Over Hostel Complaints, Protests Rock Barabanki
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An intern doctor was allegedly assaulted by the chief warden at the Mayo Institute of Medical Sciences in Safedabad, Barabanki, after he raised complaints over poor hostel facilities and unhygienic food, triggering massive protests by students on the campus.

body.html:
An intern doctor was allegedly assaulted by the chief warden at the Mayo Institute of Medical Sciences in Safedabad, Barabanki, after he raised complaints over poor hostel facilities and unhygienic food, triggering massive protests by students on the campus.

According to students, the chief warden, Awadesh Yadav, along with his associates, allegedly attacked the intern doctor with iron rods and sticks. Students who attempted to intervene were reportedly abused and threatened. A video purportedly showing the assault has since gone viral on social media.

The victim has been identified as Prabhakar Vishwas, an MBBS graduate currently undergoing internship at the institute. Police said Vishwas complained that poor-quality food and unhygienic conditions prevailed in the hostel. When he raised the issue with the chief warden around 11 am, the warden allegedly lost his temper, pushed him and dragged him inside the campus.

Vishwas further alleged that the warden called his associates and ordered them to assault him. Students who tried to stop the attack were also allegedly threatened and beaten with iron rods and sticks.

Police said the injured intern was sent for a medical examination, which revealed a deep head injury caused by a rod, along with injuries on his back and shoulder.

As news of the assault spread, hundreds of MBBS students gathered on the campus and launched a protest against the college administration. Police personnel reached the spot and tried to pacify the students, but the agitation continued for nearly two hours, with students demanding strict action against those involved.

The situation eased only after the institute’s director, Madhurika Singh, arrived and addressed the students through a public address system. She announced the immediate removal of the chief warden and assured that a new warden would be appointed. She also said legal action would be taken against those found guilty.

Police officials told the students that a case would be registered once a formal complaint was submitted and assured them that the accused would not be spared.

Meanwhile, protesting students alleged that despite charging high fees, private medical colleges fail to provide basic hostel facilities and nutritious food. They claimed that when students raise genuine concerns, they are often threatened and intimidated instead of their grievances being addressed.

articles.title: 13-Year-Old Trader’s Son Kidnapped, Murdered for Ransom in Chitrakoot; One Accused Killed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The brutal kidnapping and murder of a 13-year-old boy has triggered widespread outrage and a complete shutdown of the Bargarh market area in Chitrakoot district of Uttar Pradesh. The shocking crime has raised serious questions over law and order in the region bordering Prayagraj.

body.html:
The brutal kidnapping and murder of a 13-year-old boy has triggered widespread outrage and a complete shutdown of the Bargarh market area in Chitrakoot district of Uttar Pradesh. The shocking crime has raised serious questions over law and order in the region bordering Prayagraj.

The victim, Ayush Kesarwani alias Chhotu, was the youngest son of local businessman Ashok Kesarwani. According to police, Ayush was kidnapped in broad daylight on the evening of Thursday, January 22, 2026, from the Bargarh police station area. He was allegedly lured by his next-door neighbours, identified as Kallu alias Sahibey and Irfan Ansari, on the pretext of teaching him how to ride a motorcycle.

Soon after the abduction, the accused contacted the family and demanded a ransom of ₹40 lakh. Police said that despite the ransom demand, the kidnappers allegedly murdered the boy later the same night when the money was not paid. His body was subsequently hidden inside a box kept in a bathroom at the accused’s residence.

The crime came to light on Friday, January 23, when police recovered Ayush’s body during a search operation. Locals were left stunned when the locked box was opened and the child’s body was found inside, leading to anger and panic across the Bargarh area.

Following the recovery, police traced the accused within the Bargarh police station limits. On Friday morning, police teams surrounded the suspects. Officials said the accused opened fire at the police, prompting retaliatory action. In the encounter, one accused, Kallu alias Sahve Iman (around 70), a resident of Katra Chauraha under Ghurpur police station, was killed. The second accused, Irfan Ansari, son of Aftab Alam, was shot in the leg and taken into custody.

Police said both accused were directly involved in the kidnapping and murder of the businessman’s son. Security has been tightened across the district, and further investigation is underway to identify any additional involvement.

Meanwhile, the incident has sparked massive protests in Bargarh town. Traders and residents shut down the entire market, demanding strict action and swift justice. The Bargarh area was turned into a virtual cantonment with heavy police deployment, but public anger continues to simmer. Locals have warned that protests may intensify if justice is delayed.

articles.title: Ex-BSP Leader Abducted, Stripped and Beaten for 4 Hours in MP; Assault Video Shot to Silence Him
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A former Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) leader and 2023 Datia Assembly election candidate was allegedly abducted, stripped and brutally assaulted for nearly four hours in Madhya Pradesh’s Datia district.

body.html:
A former Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) leader and 2023 Datia Assembly election candidate was allegedly abducted, stripped and brutally assaulted for nearly four hours in Madhya Pradesh’s Datia district. The accused also recorded a video of the assault and threatened the victim with serious consequences if he approached the police.

The incident occurred on Tuesday, January 20. The victim, Lokendra Ahirwar, a resident of Kamthara village, lodged a complaint at the police station on Wednesday.

According to the complaint, Lokendra had contested the 2023 Assembly elections from Datia on a BSP ticket. He alleged that Chandraprakash Ahirwar and Umesh Ahirwar bore a political grudge against him after the elections and orchestrated the attack.

Lokendra told police that he was present in the Mandi Badauni area when Chandraprakash and Umesh approached him, claiming that a party was being held at a camp in Badauni. Trusting them, he accompanied them to the location. However, no gathering was found there.

Soon after, Raja Ahirwar, Thakurdas Ahirwar, Rajdeep Ahirwar and another unidentified youth allegedly reached the camp. The accused reportedly questioned Lokendra about his political activities and statements. They then raised slogans of “Mayawati Zindabad” and “Chandrasekhar Azad Zindabad”. When Lokendra objected, he was allegedly overpowered and beaten with sticks.

Police said Lokendra was held captive for nearly four hours and sustained injuries all over his body. During the assault, Raja Ahirwar allegedly threatened him with weapons, forcibly stripped him and recorded a video of the attack. The accused reportedly threatened to circulate the video on social media and even uploaded clips using Lokendra’s own mobile phone.

The attackers also allegedly demanded money from Lokendra. When he refused, he was beaten again, the complaint stated.

The ordeal ended when Lokendra’s father, Beniprasad Ahirwar, and another person reached the spot. Seeing them, the accused fled, allegedly warning Lokendra of dire consequences if he filed a police complaint.

Police said Lokendra had lost the 2023 election and was later removed as district president. Thereafter, he had been posting content on social media critical of the BSP and Dalits, which may have further aggravated tensions.

Investigators said the main accused, Raja Ahirwar, is a history-sheeter with multiple cases of murder and assault registered against him. He was arrested around three months ago in an attempted murder case and later released on bail. In the present case, Raja Ahirwar and his associates are absconding.

Police have registered a case and launched a manhunt to arrest all the accused.
